items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: The name 'Dick' is used exclusively as a form of address to the interviewer (e.g., 'That thing was heavily draped all the way around with velvet and boy, the bigger the band the better it sounded... That piano was so badly out of tune Dick... Now Dick, I think we were up to 50...'). There is no ment

ctx.x: Okay, Bergen we've got the third reel on.

In fact, Val was so used to using good musicians that one time I sat in with him and he heard a bad note and he kind of got on to me. So you can see the guy can always give you a good band. And it amazed me. I thought he didn't hear that note because I tried to bring it in with a chord to make it blend. Anyway I played with Barbera quite a while.
